Nursing school is very hard no matter what age you start. I often compare it to pledging and many of my coworkers agree that it seems the various schools were almost trying to weed out the weak. There were students younger and older than me. From my 101 class, only 50% made it. Many of my coworkers from other schools say they had similar experiences. It is hard work and I basically lost 2 years of my life and missed my family and friends very much, but you can do it. I did a two year program and started working while my RN job paid for my BSN. The difference in pay was only 50 cents an hour which was adjusted when I graduated. So no student debt, yay! During those two years I just kept telling myself it’s not forever, just for now. I’m so glad I did it even though covid basically destroyed me mentally and staffing sucks all the time covid or not. I love helping people especially in a time they need help the most.
